about: Mira: furigana alignment (CheerRuby.segments / stageCheerRubySegments), the same cases for the stage and the native layout. Each segment is [base] or [base, furigana]. Made-up words only.

cases.note: one kanji run takes the whole reading; punctuation takes none

cases.word: 言いたいことがあるんだよ！
cases.kana: いいたいことがあるんだよ
segments: いたいことがあるんだよ！
cases.note: kanji then kana

cases.word: 俺が生まれてきた理由！
cases.kana: おれがうまれてきたりゆう
cases.note: kanji and kana alternate
the same kana anchor repeats
the anchor kana also starts the reading
the first い after the kanji leaves the rest unfit, so the run takes one more kana
brackets take no reading
ヶ counts as kanji

cases.kana: ドキドキだいさくせん
cases.note: katakana in the word and the reading compare as hiragana
a katakana reading becomes hiragana over the kanji
spaces and punctuation in the reading are dropped
Latin letters take no reading
a name slot takes no reading
kanji inside a name slot are not read
kanji only inside a slot: no furigana
kept as before: with nothing between two kanji runs the first takes one kana
combining accent is omitted from the kana reading, without dropping the kana before it
no kanji, no furigana
no reading
an empty reading
unaligned: the reading goes over the whole word
unaligned: the leading kana is missing from the reading
unaligned: the trailing kana does not match
unaligned: too short for every kanji run to read a kana
